title: incident-bot: runbook autodiagnostics + slo-toolkit oncall helpers
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Adds automated runbook suggestions to incident-bot and new on-call helper utilities in the SLO toolkit. No breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: On-call responders often need quick, actionable diagnostics and a prioritized set of runbook steps during SLO incidents. This PR extends incident-bot with a runbook autodiagnostics pipeline that surfaces correlated SLO checks, likely root causes, and runbook snippets. It also adds lightweight on-call helper utilities to the SLO toolkit to standardize context enrichment and quick-links in alerts.

What this PR does: - incident-bot: new autodiagnostics flow that builds a short diagnostic summary from SLO telemetry, recent deploy/change events, and service traces. The output is a ranked list of likely causes + recommended runbook steps and quick links. - slo-toolkit: oncall_helpers module with utilities for building quick-links, formatting runbook snippets, and a small caching layer for runbook lookups. - Integrations: hooks that allow incident-bot to call the slo-toolkit helpers and surface results in Slack/console messages.

Implementation notes: - Autodiagnostics is implemented as a best-effort scoring function (heuristic + lightweight ML scoring) that returns suggested runbook IDs and a confidence score. We store templates for runbook snippets in /runbooks and a small index in slo-toolkit/runbook_index.json to keep lookups O(1). - To avoid noisy suggestions, we only attach autodiagnostics for incidents where at least two SLO checks are failing or where error rate spikes > 2x baseline. - Added feature flag incident.autodiag.enabled (default: false) and rollout plan documented below.

Files changed: see list below. Commits are squashed on merge.

Testing and CI: unit tests for scoring and formatting, integration tests for end-to-end Slack message enrichment. Ran a canary against staging for 48 hours with synthetic failures. All checks passed after one flaky test rerun.

Rollout plan: 1) Enable feature flag for staging and SRE team. 2) Monitor autodiag suggestion acceptance rate and false positive rate for 1 week. 3) Gradual enablement for 20% of production incidents, with ability to roll back via feature flag.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests added/updated
- [x] Integration tests for Slack messages
- [x] Feature flag added
- [x] Docs updated (inline runbook templates + usage)
- [x] Security review for runbook lookup (no secrets exposed)

Related: Linear ENG-4123 (runbook autodiagnostics), ENG-3987 (slo-toolkit oncall helpers).
